questions.q: What is Self Service Procurement designed to let ordinary employees do?
options: Approve purchase orders without any oversight
Request goods and services directly for themselves or others, without needing to be a dedicated buyer
Edit the chart of accounts
Negotiate supplier contracts directly
questions.explain: Self Service Procurement lets any employee submit a request for what they need, pushing ordinary purchasing volume out to the people who need the items.

questions.q: Why is Dana able to find the PB-4400 pump bearing by simply searching, instead of typing a full manual description?
options: Because all items in Oracle Fusion are entered manually every time
Because punchout is required for every item
Because it is set up as a catalog item with a pre-loaded description, category, and price
Because smart forms are required for every item
questions.explain: A recurring MRO item like the PB-4400 is typically set up in a catalog so requesters can search and add it directly.

questions.q: What is a non-catalog request used for?
options: Items that already exist in a pre-loaded catalog
Canceling an already-approved purchase order
Only requests made by procurement managers
Items that are not in any catalog, requiring the requester to manually enter a description, category, estimated price, and supplier
questions.explain: A non-catalog request lets a requisition continue even when the needed item has no existing catalog entry, by capturing the details manually.

questions.q: What does a requisition line's distribution determine?
options: Which cost center, project, or account the purchase should be charged to
The supplier's remittance bank account
The receiving clerk's name
The payment terms on the eventual invoice
questions.explain: The distribution on a requisition line is where the accounting - which cost center or project absorbs the cost - is determined.

questions.q: What is true about a requisition that has been submitted but not yet approved?
options: It has already created a binding purchase order with the supplier
It skips the approval process entirely because it came from self service
It automatically pays the supplier immediately
It has no effect on the supplier and cannot become a purchase order until it is approved
questions.explain: A requisition is only a request. It must be approved and then processed into a purchase order before it has any effect on a supplier.
